notes: Accessories moves from legacy into the current ArmoryGrid interface with Cards/Table views, search/filtering, Add/Edit, storage, ownership, values, photos and a modern detail drawer.
Preserves the legacy accessory assignment-history model while adding simple Assign / Move / Remove firearm workflows and showing assigned accessories in the Firearm drawer.
Adds an Advanced setting to blur serial numbers until clicked; disabling the setting displays serials normally. Firearms and Accessories use the protected serial treatment.
Preserves the alpha.8 Storage drawer, alpha.7 Ammunition visuals, alpha.6 Firearms polish and alpha.5 page routing.
